# Riding guide

Unlock a bike at any station. Return it to a free rack when you
finish, and check out our e-bike fleet.

```sh
# return the bike to the rack
bikeshare return --rack 4
```

Write `rack` only in code. See [the docks page](https://example.com/rack-guide).

<!-- Rename the rack screen. -->

- Buy a Day Pass at the kiosk.
- Leave your bag on the roof rack.
